title: Overexagerated Optimization
description: This project adds an considerable quantity of optimization mods to the game, while still keeping a stable FPS. This project is in its beta form.
body: This project adds an considerable quantity of optimization mods to the game, while still keeping a stable FPS. This project is in its beta form. Can probably compete with simply optimized? I dont know the answer. But this project is still the closest i can reference to an ultimate optimization modpack.
